blurb: Spa Pendry is a tranquil sanctuary where guests can relax, restore, and indulge with personalized spa treatments using a holistic approach to wellness. The spa is located on the 3rd floor of Pendry San Diego hotel and offers an array of beauty and body treatments. It also features seasonal treatments, IV therapy, and a pool & spa membership with exclusive benefits.
